notes:
Summary: VerityHelm builds an enterprise support search layer used by 2,800 customers (SaaS). Primary goal: reduce live-agent escalations by 25% through RAG-based support agent + ticket deflection. Heavy emphasis on top-5 quality for reranking and strict end-to-end latency SLOs.

Key constraints and asks (from AE/SE calls):
- Index size: ~50M documents (ticket threads, KB articles, transcripts) with 120M total vectors after ephemeral augmentation.
- QPS: baseline 180 qps with peaks 800 qps (endpoints across NA+EU).
- Latency: retrieval+rerank p95 target <= 150ms for deflection API (user-facing), allowed batch up to 300ms for internal agent assist.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost-per-query <= $0.003 (embeddings+ANN lookup+reranker inference).
- Reranker expectation: cross-encoder reranker only on top-100 candidates; final top-5 precision target >= 0.85 (human eval).
- Model prefs: prefer open LLMs for reranker (lower inference cost) but open to Redwood-curated variants. Must support quantized models and GPU pooling.
- Infrastructure: want Dedicated pools with deterministic throughput; fallback to Hosted for overflow. VPC private control plane required.

CRM style notes:
- "SE demo looked good; Diego suggested two-stage rerank (bi-encoder candidates -> cross-encoder top-100) -> matches our plan"
- Legal asked for KMS integration and residency for EU customer subset.
- Finance flag: needs clear unit economics before procurement.
- Customer team: Head of Search = Priya Nair, Eng mgr = Tomas Svensson.

Proposed POC scope: evaluate Redwood Dedicated with 2 GPU nodes, run indexing job for 5M sample docs, measure end-to-end p95 and top-5 precision after integrating Redwood Optimize batch suggestions. 3-week POC, deliverables: p95 latency report, cost per query projection, reranker eval (MRR + precision@5).
